correctness.rationale: PASS. For the unit-rate continuous-time walk on depth-two regular T_{b,k}, b,k≥2, unique tree-edge flows give exact W1=ell1 edge norm; e^{-tBB^T}B=B e^{-tB^TB} reduces the operator norm to maximal abs edge-column sum. The edge Laplacian splits into b(k−1) contrasts eigenvalue 1 and two symmetric 2×2 blocks S,G. Counting branch/orbit entries gives the stated I_{b,k},O_{b,k} all-time formulas exactly. Along b=k=N, entrywise Metzler comparison implies 0≤G≤S; spectral slow/fast mode yields I≤4−10/N+O(N^-2); at t=3log N/N, I meets this to O(log N/N²). Uniform O≤3+2/sqrt N excludes domination at large N. Strictly positive finite-chain transition kernels prevent attaining diameter four. Independent complete edge matrix exponentials agreed with block formulas to <2e-14 for four parameter triples; finite test is supplemental.
residual_risks: The exact first-order asymptotic is proved along b=k=N only, not arbitrary jointly growing b,k.
The independent finite checks sample small trees; general theorem rests on analytic block decomposition and spectral bounds.
